title: Impact Of British Policy On Indian Economy
definition: The systematic, structural transformation and colonial subordination of the traditional self-sufficient Indian economy into a raw material exporter and a captive market for British manufactured goods.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Modern Indian History under GS-1 (Indian Freedom Struggle & Post-Independence consolidation history) and GS-3 (Indian Economy, Colonial Exploitation, Deindustrialization, and Agrarian Crisis).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Impact Of British Policy On Indian Economy.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
